title: aⁿbⁿcⁿ needs context
notes: CB → BC has two symbols on its left, so the grammar is not context-free. No rule shrinks the string, and S → ε is allowed because S is on no right side, so it is context-sensitive. Place shows why no context-free grammar could do better.
ops: S -> T | eps; T -> aTBC | aBC; CB -> BC; aB -> ab; bB -> bb; bC -> bc; cC -> cc
